paragraphs.text: Reveler is a class for creatures who are partying or celebrating. It was introduced in the Defeat a God Challenge Deck from the Theros block and is not legal in a regular Magic game.

Reveler was introduced as a class specific to Satyrs , Humans , Centaurs and Nymphs . All cards in the Xenagos Deck, including Revelers on the battlefield , are colorless and have a mana value of 0. Players can't gain control of any Revelers. If a Reveler would go to any zone other than Xenagos's graveyard, it's put into Xenagos's graveyard instead. Most Reveler offer a Hero's Reward when defeated.
